 Introduction 
 Patrick 
My guest this week is Fidji Simo, the CEO of Instacart. Fidji grew up in a small town in the south of France and was the first person in her family to graduate from high school. Since then, she's had a dazzling career, with stops at France's leading university, eBay and Facebook. Fidji spent the better half of a decade at Facebook, where she led the Facebook app before joining Instacart in mid-2021.

 We talk about Fidji's consumer product experiences, Instacart's role within the grocery ecosystem and delve into her personal leadership philosophy. Please enjoy this wide-ranging discussion with the Fidji Simo.

 Before we get to the episode, I'm also excited to announce that I am hiring for a new position to come work with me and my team at my investing firm Positive Sum. We are calling the open position an investigative research analyst, which will become a critical part of our investment diligence function.
